verdict.rationale: Sardine's marketing pages describe built-in AI agents that automate KYC/AML alert reviews, clear false positives, do supporting research, and route higher-risk matches to analysts. That counts as delegating specific compliance tasks to in-product AI. The evidence covers only these narrow, pre-defined workflows, not a general assistant users can direct, and comes only from vendor marketing. Missing for 10: evidence of a general-purpose in-product assistant users can hand arbitrary tasks to, documentation of how users invoke or direct the agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AI agents clear obvious false positives, perform supporting research, and route higher-risk matches for analyst review.
